description: Issue #286 review: chained end filters keep the same eligible witness and its tags.
grammar:
%rule text a "b" "c"
%rule a "a"
%rule r short | middle | long
%rule short "a" :: Short
%rule middle "a" "b" :: Middle
%rule long "a" "b" "c" :: Long
%check ends #·a
%conditions $.onward.parse(r …).ending-after($.following-node).ending-after($).error-free.tags = Long
%warning "long"
